preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of buses k must be between 1 and 10^9.
The number of days d must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n > k else True
postconditions.description: If the number of students exceeds the number of buses, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bus <= k for bus in buses for buses in output)
postconditions.description: Each bus number assigned to a student must be between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == d and all(len(buses) == n for buses in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain d lines, each with n integers representing bus assignments.
